description:
My Property Box are delighted to offer to the market this stunning, well proportioned two bedroom ground floor apartment, complete with a private balcony and enviable views across the beautifully landscaped communal grounds of St Mary-s Park, Stannington.

The property briefly comprises an entrance hallway with a large storage cupboard, security alarm system and video intercom providing secure access. There is a spacious living room with a dedicated dining area, featuring lovely views over the communal grounds.

The apartment also boasts a stylish contemporary kitchen, fitted with a range of integrated appliances including a washing machine, dishwasher, electric oven, gas hob and fridge freezer.

There are two generously sized double bedrooms, with the master bedroom benefiting from a modern en-suite shower room and access to the private balcony via double-glazed French doors. A fully tiled family bathroom completes the internal accommodation. Externally, the property further benefits from a garage and private allocated parking space.

To arrange a viewing, contact My Property Box today on 0191 212 0400 and speak with our Lettings Team.
